data.title: Second reminder from NetzMuster – €49.99 due
data.summary: NetzMuster GmbH sent a second reminder (2. Mahnung) dated 26 March 2026 for the unpaid February 2026 invoice. The total is €49.99 (€44.99 plus a €5.00 reminder fee), to be received by 7 April 2026.
data.explanation: Your internet provider says the February 2026 invoice is still unpaid, despite a payment reminder of 12 March 2026. A €5.00 reminder fee has been added. Pay €49.99 so it arrives by 7 April 2026. If you don't, the provider reserves the right to block your connection (Sperre). If you already paid, the letter says to treat it as settled. Check that the invoice and the fee are correct, and keep your proof of payment.
